subject: Evaluation acceptance & milestone calendar — kickoff availability and handoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Hiro Nakamura <hiro@finovate.co>, Emily Torres <etorres@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation acceptance & milestone calendar — kickoff availability and handoff

Hi Hiro / Emily — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth going into the trial planning: 

Summary of agreement from discovery call:
- Evaluation goal: validate Redwood Hosted inference for payment reconciliation assistant (reduce manual reconciliation time by >= 45%; accuracy target >= 92% on reconciliation labels).
- Scope: 2-week integration + 3-week evaluation (total 5 weeks) covering 2 typical reconciliation flows and one failure scenario test.
- Success criteria: reconciliation accuracy >= 92% on evaluation dataset, average inference latency <= 350ms p50, and reproducible test harness for readout.

Proposed milestones (first pass):
1) Kickoff + environment access (Week 0): account provisioning, dataset transfer, VPN/Kerberos as needed.
2) Integration sprint (Week 1–2): data ingest, mapping, example prompts, smoke tests.
3) Evaluation run (Week 3–5): scheduled runs, monitoring, and weekly checkpoints.
4) Final readout (end of Week 5): results, decision rubric, recommended next steps (dedicated vs hosted).

Ownership (suggested):
- Redwood PM: Vivek Kulkarni (overall cadence & readout)
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Aditya Rao (integration support, SDK bits)
- Redwood CS: Laura Bennett (check-ins, acceptance tests)
- StratusPay technical lead: Hiro Nakamura (data & infra access)

Immediate asks / can we confirm by EOD?
- Hiro: confirm VPN access window and preferred kickoff date (we are holding Tue 21 or Thu 23 next week for a 60-minute kickoff).
- Emily: confirm legal/POC SOW path (do you want a lightweight statement of work or a one-pager we can sign?)

Attachments: I will attach a first-draft milestone calendar and a POC SOW template for your review.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183
--
Attachment stubs: 20260418-viv-milestone-calendar.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-poc-sow-draft.docx (doc)

From: Emily Torres <etorres@stratuspay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation acceptance & milestone calendar — kickoff availability and handoff

Thanks Vivek — this looks great and aligns with what we need. Couple quick clarifications: 

1) Success criteria: the 92% accuracy threshold is fine but can we add an operational acceptance gate for false positives (FP rate < 6%) so our ops team can evaluate manual review overhead?
2) Data transfer: we will provide a 3-day rolling sample initially; full dataset availability targeted by Week 1 end.
3) Legal: we prefer the lightweight SOW + an NDAs addendum; finance will do an internal PO only after the readout if we proceed.

Kickoff: Thu 23 works best for us at 10:00 AM PT. We can provide our infra contact in the kickoff invite.

Emily Torres
Head of Payments Product | StratusPay
etorres@stratuspay.com
+1 617-555-0124

Nice recap, Vivek — adding a couple operational items and suggested weekly check-in format: 

Operational notes:
- Acceptance tests: we'll run a nightly batch on Week 4 with the evaluation harness and generate a pass/fail report for each success criterion.
- Monitoring: Redwood will provision a temporary Grafana dashboard for latency/throughput within the first 48 hours of kickoff.
- Escalation: primary contact for infra issues will be Aditya Rao; backup is Vivek.

Weekly check-ins (30 minutes):
- Wednesdays @ 9:00 AM PT (status, blockers, next 7 days).
- Ad hoc deep-dive sessions scheduled as needed for integration issues.

I'll also circulate a short checklist for the kickoff (account IDs, VPN users, sample dataset location, S3 permissions). Vivek — happy to own check-ins if you want to focus on the readout and commercial timeline.

—Laura
Director of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

- Added FP rate < 6% as an acceptance gate (Week 5 final readout).
